# netactuate_router_ntp (Resource)

Beta. The cloud router family is in beta: behaviour and schema may change. Manages the NTP service on a cloud router.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_router_ntp" "example" {
  enabled   = true
  router_id = 12345
  upstreams {
    domain = "example"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether or not NTP is enabled.
- `router_id` (Number) The ID of the cloud router.
- `upstreams` (Block List, Min: 1) The upstream NTP servers to use by the cloud router. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--upstreams))

### Optional

- `interface_id` (Number) You may restrict the NTP service to a specific interface.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--upstreams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `upstreams`

Required:

- `domain` (String) The hostname of the NTP server, like time.cloudflare.com.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_router_ntp.example 12345
```
